Resolves #20971

Related: #20682, #20987

Adds `Portal.view.home.parts.AudienceDoors` immediately after the Hero stage on Portal Home (`/` and `#/home`), extracts `.portal-glass-card` and its eight `--portal-glass-card-*` theme tokens into `Viewport.scss` across `src`, `theme-neo-dark`, and `theme-neo-light`, shares `$portal-home-snap-max-width: 840px` via `home/_breakpoints.scss`, emits crawlable public proof and section anchors in the real `middleware-v2` `/` and `/home` SSR snapshots while preserving reference-based browser scrolling (`'home-audience-doors'`, `'home-body-entry'`, `'home-agent-os'`), and ships Option A as the fallback (`AC-1`) while #20987 holds Screen 1 unprompted continuation-discovery closure and `@tobiu` visual selection among Options B, C, or a scroll cue.

Evidence: L4 (headed Chromium 36-frame matrix across `1440×900`, `1440×800`, `900×700`, and `390×844` in `neo-dark` and `neo-light` + Whitebox Neural Link E2E + real `middleware-v2` `/` and `/home` SSR snapshot navigability check + unprimed two-phase cold-reader baseline matrix) → L4 required (`AC-1`, `AC-2`, `AC-3`, `AC-5`, `AC-7`, `AC-8`). Residual: AC-8 (Screen 1 unprompted continuation discovery on fallback Option A & `@tobiu` visual selection), Residual-Owner: #20987.

- Added matching 1-line monospace anchor chips (`neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institution` on Door 2; `MX · Two Hemispheres · Gated RSI` on Door 3) pinned via `margin-top: auto` alongside Door 1's `$ npx neo-app@latest`, and linked Door 3's `Proof:` row to `#/learn/benefits/Introduction` so all three `.portal-glass-card` columns share aligned horizontal baselines on desktop (`Phase 2` cold-reader stepping-back polish).
